channel.title: AI Bar
channel.description: Auto-update feed for AI Bar — the experimental build of the Claude Code menu-bar manager.

item.title: AI Bar 0.13
item.description:
• Each usage card (Today / This week / This month) now shows a cost-equivalent figure under the raw total — tokens weighted by Anthropic's per-flow price ratios (output 5×, cache write 1.25×, cache read 0.1×). Reflects billable weight, not raw volume that cache reads dominate.
  • Ratios are identical across the Claude model lineup, so the figure is exact regardless of model mix — no dollar price table needed.
  • Hover a card for the full per-component breakdown including the cost-equivalent.

item.title: AI Bar 0.12
item.description:
• Token usage totals now count every component — input, output, cache writes, and cache reads — so the figure reflects all tokens processed (matches ccusage). Previously cache reads were excluded, undercounting heavy sessions.
  • Per-component breakdown (input / output / cache write / cache read) still shown in the tooltip.
  • Note: stats cover Claude Code usage (terminal CLI + IDE extension) only — web claude.ai and direct API calls aren't in the local logs.

item.title: AI Bar 0.11
item.description:
• Fixes a stuck red "Sign in" usage badge on an account that's actually working — it's the web-usage source, not your CLI login.
  • Root cause: claude.ai's usage API started returning timestamps with fractional seconds the app couldn't parse, so usage reads kept failing.
  • The badge only clears on a successful read, so signing in via Safari didn't help until this fix.

item.title: AI Bar 0.10
item.description:
• No more signing in every morning — the active account's sign-in token is no longer invalidated overnight by background refresh.
  • Active account usage now reads from the live token Claude Code keeps fresh, instead of the app refreshing and rotating it.
  • Under the hood: AI Bar never refreshes the active account's tokens — Claude Code owns that cycle.

item.title: AI Bar 0.9
item.description:
• Netbird group roles, colors, notes, and the people directory now sync across your Macs via iCloud Drive.
  • Open the app on a new Mac and the access matrix appears with the same dev/server columns you set up on the original.
  • Fixes the missing matrix on a second Mac caused by per-machine UserDefaults.

item.title: AI Bar 0.8
item.description:
• Adding a GitLab MCP instance now rejects URLs that duplicate an existing one.
  • Duplicate detection normalizes case, trailing slash, and a trailing /api/v4.
  • Fixes silent “ambiguous gitlab instance” errors from the MCP tool surface.

item.title: AI Bar 0.7
item.description:
• New “Theo dõi CI” tool in Daily → Tools: one-click install of ci-watch + glpush.
  • After every git push, your GitLab/GitHub pipeline is watched in the background and you're notified when it finishes.
  • GitLab auth reuses your saved MCP GitLab token; an inline form lets you fill it in Tools if none is set yet.

item.title: AI Bar 0.6
item.description:
• Disk analyzer can now deep-scan — finds the biggest folders at any depth, not just top-level.
  • Each large folder shows its path, so you can see exactly what's eating space.
  • Ask AI for cleanup advice — it flags what's safe to delete (caches, logs, build, node_modules).

item.title: AI Bar 0.5
item.description:
• Fix: chat, the server assistant and the AI advisor failed to start ("claude binary not on PATH") when the app was launched from Finder.
  • The Sao lưu server assistant now works — chat with Claude to install and configure a server over SSH.

item.title: AI Bar 0.4
item.description:
• Sao lưu tab — back up a Docker app and database to SharePoint on a daily server-side schedule.
  • Server assistant — chat with Claude to install and configure a server over SSH.
  • Read-only commands run automatically; server changes ask for confirmation first.
  • Sao lưu moved out of the App sidebar into its own top-level Tools tab.

item.title: AI Bar 0.3
item.description:
• Tools tab — macOS maintenance utilities right inside the Daily window.
  • Agentic Workspace action inbox to capture and act on items.
  • cbar CLI shortcut; switch accounts by label, nickname or email.

item.title: AI Bar 0.2
item.description:
• Chat tab in the Daily window — auto-growing composer, slimmer header, more room for the thread.
  • New Netbird mode — manage peers, people, roles, notes and SSH right from Daily.
  • Editorial Plan briefing with a menu-bar tether glow.
  • Pause background activity (dormant) mode to idle the app on demand.
  • Shows the real app name throughout instead of a hardcoded "Claude Bar" label.
